title: MSc in Machine Learning & Artificial Intelligence
about: Stellenbosch University's one-year MSc in Machine Learning & Artificial Intelligence accepts applications for the January 2027 intake until 31 October 2026. Google DeepMind scholarships for African students were tied to applications submitted by 15 August 2026.
requirements: See the programme's "How to apply" page for admission requirements
Google DeepMind Scholarships (administered by IIE) are for students from Africa

upskill.name: Machine Learning - Foundations & Methods I
why: "Machine learning" (record skill) → "Supervised learning: classification, regression, decision trees, SVMs, ensemble methods"
"Machine learning, artificial intelligence" (record field) → "Unsupervised learning: clustering (k-means, DBSCAN), dimensionality reduction (PCA, t-SNE, UMAP)"

card_alt: Card for the MSc in Machine Learning & Artificial Intelligence at Stellenbosch University in Stellenbosch, South Africa, with an application deadline of 31 Oct 2026. The photo shows the stone elephant statues and domed towers of the Palace of the Lost City at Sun City, South Africa.
